name: monitoring--metrics-export
description: Services export Prometheus metrics on correct ports and paths

implementation.change: Ensure all services expose metrics endpoints: litellm:4000/metrics, headroom:8787/metrics, qdrant:6333/metrics

checks: LiteLLM container exposes port 4000 and has /metrics endpoint
Headroom container exposes port 8787 and has /metrics endpoint
Qdrant container exposes port 6333 and has /metrics endpoint
Prometheus can scrape all three targets without errors

disabled_reason: Superseded 2026-09-20: koeff-ai-stack is stopped (koeff_ai_stack_state: absent, eval 029). This eval validates a service that no longer runs — the LLM-routing chain (litellm, headroom, nginx-ingest, qdrant, ollama, postgres) was decommissioned 2026-08-31 and the prometheus + grafana pair that outlived it was stopped 2026-09-20. Several of these evals also point at template files that were deleted with those services. Re-enable only if the stack is restored.
